Package neqsim.mcp.runners

Class ResponseSizeGuard

java.lang.Object
neqsim.mcp.runners.ResponseSizeGuard
public final class ResponseSizeGuard extends Object
Keeps MCP tool responses within a size an agent and a transport can actually handle.

A full plant model produces a per-unit property report measured in megabytes. Such a response is useless to a language model — it exhausts the context window before any reasoning happens — and a single multi-megabyte JSON-RPC line can break the stdio transport, ending the session rather than returning an answer.

When a response exceeds the configured limit, the bulky payload members are dropped in descending size order until the response fits. The envelope (status, tool, validation, quality gate, provenance) is never dropped, and a truncation block records what was omitted and how to retrieve it selectively — normally by registering the model with manageModel and drilling in through listSimulationUnits and getSimulationVariable.

The limit is configurable through the neqsim.mcp.maxResponseBytes system property or the NEQSIM_MCP_MAX_RESPONSE_BYTES environment variable. Set it to 0 to disable trimming.

1.0
